# VICEPRINT

VICEPRINT builds a digital nail printer for professional studios. This is a presale landing page for the first production batch — a reservation is not a completed sale, and both reservation tiers are fully refundable until the unit ships.

## Key facts

- What it is: a digital nail printer that prints full nail art while the client waits — no specialist needed for detailed work, no limit on the design library.
- Reservation model: pay a deposit or prepay now to secure a unit from the first production batch; a reservation is not a sale and is refundable in full until shipping.
- Tiers: Reserve — €750 (50% deposit, €749 balance before shipping). Founder — €1,499 (100% prepay).
- Both tiers are refundable at any time until the unit ships.
- Specs are flagged for confirmation with the manufacturing partner before launch (unconfirmed figures are marked TBD, never shipped as confirmed).
